text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
To everyone's surprise, in 1st place is 
Espoir City! It's Espoir City!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... ......âI won.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...I won!! I won, I won, I won――...!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Heeey!! I won, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She rushed right into the winner's circle. 
Swept up in her sheer excitement, my own 
cheeks began to warm up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right?! We won, didn't we! We totally won, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then give me that! Hand it over! Even 
yours is fine! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's a smartphone!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You have Mom's contact info on yours too, 
don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hello, Mom!? Did you see it!? Did you—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hell yeah, I won. I was totally 
unstoppable."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...This is your daughter, bastard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her boast proudly to her mother, I 
felt certain she had achieved the results 
she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If she were truly a "weak Umamusume," 
there is no way she could take 1st place 
in a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This should curb any reckless actions born 
from a lack of confidence. For she has 
gained the weapon needed to fight the 
anxiety nesting in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If that is the case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she should do next is surely to 
confront her own anxieties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than relying on the lie of being 
the "strongest Umamusume," confronting 
your inner weakness and overcoming it. 
That is the true—
choice_data_list: (I know it will lead to true growth...)
(It should lead to true growth... right?)

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak! 
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any 
stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—It started back then. That's when she 
began rebelling like a raging fire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, Espoir City received that 
coaching and failed once before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To foster growth, one must be made to 
acknowledge their own weakness. This is a 
universal truth.
choice_data_list: (Still, this method isn't suited for her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, is this truly the only way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this method truly the only way she 
can grow?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (At last, I was able to show Mom.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(A strong me that they can believe in. A 
reliable... strong me.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Because—it was different.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"‘Admit that what you can't do, you can't 
do!! You idiot...!!’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... You're weak as hell, so stop 
pushing yourself so damn hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I was wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I was strong enough to turn everything 
around— his words, his attitude, all of 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'll make them acknowledge me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll make her acknowledge me! 
To do that—...!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's a photo of a trophy in the old 
man's room, right? ...What was that from?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that thing! Apparently, it belonged to 
the "Best Dirt Horse Girl" that Chief was 
involved with back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
"She's the top of the top on dirt, after 
all! It's only natural for the Chief who 
raised her to be proud~."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...My old man's pride...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Espoir City returned to the 
waiting room, she let out a loud shout.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna become the greatest dirt horse 
girl out there."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's a huge award, right?! Even I know 
that much!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanna take it. ...That's what I 
wanna become.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna shatter that damn old man's 
words into pieces— that 'I'm weak.'

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Which race should I conquer next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Best Dirt Umamusume." It is an annual URA 
award presented to the Umamusume who 
showed the most outstanding performance on 
dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because the award winners are determined 
by a vote among those involved, there are 
originally no set criteria such as which 
specific races one must win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there is a certain tendency 
regarding which race winners are more 
likely to be chosen.
choice_data_list: Let's go for the Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...The Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An 1800m race held at Chukyo Racecourse in 
December. It's also called the ultimate 
showdown on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who wins this race is very 
likely to be chosen as the Best Dirt 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —...It's settled, then!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit pulses within her 
eyes. A burning passion flickers there.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah~...! Amazing, Espo-san is so 
amazing! She took 1st in the Mile 
Championship Nambu Hai!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both the race and the interview were 
simply magnificent~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The veteran, grandma-like Umamusume, 
Wonder Acute, flashed a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san's next goal is the Champions Cup, 
apparently! I won't be in the same race, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to enter a different big race 
at the end of the year, after all☆ Ugh... 
I gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was never supposed to make it to the 
year-end concert— but I'm gonna make it 
just in time!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, now, now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, allow me to be your opponent 
first.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My heart is totally ablaze. 'Let's try 
surpassing Espo-san,' she said.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Facing stronger opponents is exactly what 
fires me up! Fuhoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And beneath the starlight, the Umamusume 
begin their march, aiming to become the 
champion.
